segments.speaker: Maya Patel, Customer
segments.text:
Hi Jordan,

Can you send the final quote for 42 seats of the platform plus implementation? Target go-live is September 16. We need annual billing, net 30, and the service dates should line up to start September 1 if possible.

Maya

segments.speaker: Jordan Lee, Rep
segments.text:
Hi Maya,

For 42 seats, annual subscription is $42,840. Standard implementation is $3,000, but I can include that at no charge if we keep the September 1 start date.

Term would be 12 months, September 1, 2026 through August 31, 2027. Annual invoice on signature, net 30.

Jordan

segments.speaker: Maya Patel, Customer
segments.text: Thanks. Finance is asking whether we can keep year one under $40,000 all-in. The business owner is good with the September 16 go-live, but I need a number they can approve before Thursday’s procurement cutoff.

segments.speaker: Jordan Lee, Rep
segments.text: Yeah, understood. I’m checking what room we have on the first-year subscription. No issue on the go-live date from our side as long as we have the user list by September 4.

segments.speaker: Maya Patel, Customer
segments.text: The $39,200 you sent over chat works for us. If that is the number, I can get the PO started today. The order form link still shows $42,840, so send me the version we should attach when it catches up.

segments.speaker: Jordan Lee, Rep
segments.text: Yes, use $39,200 for the PO amount. I’ll get the updated order form over after the system reflects it. Same terms: 42 seats, annual billing, net 30, September 1 start.

segments.speaker: Maya Patel, Customer
segments.text:
Got it. Billing entity is Northlake Components, Inc., 1180 Summit Ave, Dayton, OH 45402. AP email is invoices@northlakecomponents.com.

Please list the cost center as OPS-214 on the invoice if there is a field for it.

segments.speaker: Jordan Lee, Rep
segments.text: Thanks. I’ll include the billing details and cost center note. I’ll also send the implementation kickoff dates so your team can pick a slot the week of August 26.
